Estimate from YouTube’s top %1$d results, not real search volume (YouTube does not share it).
How is the score worked out?

Demand is 70 percent how many views a day the top results get (10,000 a day is the top of the scale) plus 30 percent how many were uploaded in the last 90 days. Competition is 60 percent how many top results come from channels bigger than yours plus 40 percent how many have the exact words in the title (only the second part when channel sizes are unknown). Score is 60 percent demand plus 40 percent of how little competition there is. Every number comes from YouTube’s top results at the time of the search.
